why: Stale at the top: written 8:16 am, it still says the toss was 'reported to be due at 8:05 am IST' and play had not begun. It is now past 8:30 am IST, so the toss has happened or been put off again, and the overs may have been cut. The main picture is also wrong: a file photo of Shreyas Iyer speaking into a mic at an Indian ground. He is not mentioned anywhere in the story, and a rain-delay story has to show the rain.
